name: get_market_conditions
description: Get current local real estate market conditions for a zip code: median price, days on market, inventory, months of supply, buyer/seller market indicator, sale-to-list ratio, and per-property-type breakdown.

name: get_neighborhood_analysis
description: Get neighborhood analysis for an address: walk/transit/bike scores, school ratings, crime statistics, demographics, nearby amenities, and growth trends.

address.description: Full property address to analyze the surrounding neighborhood

name: get_market_forecast
description: Forecast home price trends for a zip code: monthly forecasted median prices with widening confidence intervals, total and annualized change, risk factors, and positive drivers.

name: get_market_trends
description: Get historical real estate market trends for a zip code: monthly time-series of median price, price/sqft, sales volume, days on market, and inventory, with change summary.

period.description: Time period for trend data (One of: 3m, 6m, 1y, 3y, 5y; Default: 1y)
